finding_verdicts.reason: The parent-directory sequences appear in HTML breadcrumb links to repository documentation. They do not perform filesystem operations or process attacker-controlled paths.
Backticks mark get_workspace_list as an inline MCP tool name in Markdown. The surrounding text requests account identification, not shell execution.
The get_theme_list name is inline Markdown describing how to inspect existing themes. There is no executable shell or Ruby context.
The backticks format apply_quiz_theme, create_theme, and update_theme as MCP tool names. These documented theme operations are not shell command substitutions.
The manage_theme reference describes theme ordering and deletion through an MCP tool. Its Markdown backticks do not execute commands.
The get_workspace_report_appearance reference documents reading current appearance settings. The backticks are Markdown formatting, with no shell execution context.
The update_workspace_report_palette reference names an MCP operation, not an executable shell expression. Adjacent instructions explicitly warn that palette changes affect every report.
The backticks identify MCP tools for creating and deleting appearance presets. These are documented application operations, not Ruby or shell command execution.
The three inline names identify branding and logo MCP tools. Surrounding prose explains account scope and plan restrictions, without any shell execution instructions.

content.user_title: Customize WebAsk Survey and Report Appearance
content.value_statement: Survey themes and report branding can become inconsistent across client work. This skill guides WebAsk appearance changes while explaining shared settings and reusing existing themes.
actual_capabilities: Guides account selection and inspection of existing themes before creating a new theme.
Guides applying, creating, updating, ordering, and deleting survey themes through WebAsk MCP tools.
Guides reading report appearance and updating chart palettes, with warnings about account-wide effects.
Guides creating and deleting saved report appearance presets for different clients.
Guides account branding changes and logo uploads or removals, while explaining copyright visibility restrictions.
Recommends readable mobile contrast and chart colors that remain distinguishable in grayscale print.
limitations: Requires access to the listed WebAsk MCP tools; the package does not implement those tools.
Report palettes and branding apply across the account, not only to one survey or report.
Copyright hiding depends on the account plan and cannot be enabled by bypassing plan restrictions.
Provides design guidance but does not include automated contrast checks, print previews, or logo generation.

use_cases.title: Match a survey to company branding
use_cases.description: Select an existing theme or adjust survey colors to match approved buttons, backgrounds, and logos.

use_cases.title: Prepare readable client reports
use_cases.description: Review chart palettes for visual distinction and grayscale printing before proposing account-wide changes.

use_cases.title: Organize appearance presets for clients
use_cases.description: Create named report appearance presets for client work while keeping shared account branding changes explicit.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect available themes
prompt_templates.prompt: List existing themes in [account]. Recommend one for [survey] using [brand colors], without changing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a survey theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Match [survey] in [account] to [button color] and [background color]. Reuse a suitable theme and confirm the selection before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Review the report palette
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the report palette in [account]. Recommend colors for mobile readability and grayscale printing. Explain account-wide effects and wait for approval before updating.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate client presets and branding
prompt_templates.prompt: Review themes, report appearance, and branding in [account]. Propose presets for [clients] and changes using [approved logo]. Confirm each shared change or deletion before execution.

output_examples.input: Make this survey match our green buttons and white background.
output: I will check existing themes before proposing a new one.
Please identify the account and survey, and provide the approved button color.
I will recommend a matching theme and ask for confirmation before applying it.

output_examples.input: Change the chart colors for one client report.
output: The chart palette is shared across the account. Changing it affects all reports.
I recommend reviewing saved appearance presets for this client.
I will wait for approval before changing the shared palette.

output_examples.input: Our plan does not support hiding the copyright notice. Can you remove it?
output_examples.output: Copyright hiding is unavailable on this plan. I cannot enable that restricted setting. We can still review supported theme and logo options.

best_practices: Identify the target account and survey, inspect current settings, and reuse suitable themes before creating new ones.
Confirm account-wide palette or branding changes and explicitly approve deletions before using write tools.
Use a small survey palette, readable mobile contrast, and chart colors that remain distinguishable in grayscale.
anti_patterns: Changing the shared palette for one report without informing other account users.
Creating duplicate themes without checking existing options.
Assuming copyright hiding is available on every plan or suggesting a plan change solely for that setting.

faq.question: What does this skill configure?
faq.answer: It guides survey themes, report chart palettes, saved appearance presets, account branding, and logos through WebAsk MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it work without WebAsk MCP access?
faq.answer: No. Applying changes requires access to the listed WebAsk MCP tools and the target account.

faq.question: Can I change the palette for only one report?
faq.answer: The documented palette update affects all reports in the account. The skill warns about this scope and discusses saved appearance presets.

faq.question: Will it always create a new survey theme?
faq.answer: No. It checks existing themes first and recommends reusing a suitable option.

faq.question: Can it hide the WebAsk copyright notice on every plan?
faq.answer: No. Copyright visibility depends on the account plan. The instructions prohibit recommending a plan change solely to hide it.

faq.question: Does it automatically test accessibility or generate logos?
faq.answer: No. It offers contrast and print-readability guidance and references logo upload tools, but includes no automated accessibility testing or logo generation.
